name: Star Border
description: Button or link with a canvas-drawn light that travels around its rounded border, leaving a glowing trail, with optional sparkles, hover effects and a click pulse. Dark and light themes.
contents: Polymorphic root element (button by default) with children as content
Canvas overlay drawing the animated star light, trail, glow and dust particles around the border
behavior: One or more star heads continuously travel around the rounded border with a fading trail
Hover mode lap makes the star do an extra eased lap on pointer enter or keyboard focus
Hover mode brighten raises glow while hovered or focused
Hover mode reveal hides the star until hover and starts it at the pointer position
Click or tap emits a pulse in both directions from the press point and flashes the border
Sparkle option adds cross-shaped star cores and drifting dust
Animation loop pauses when offscreen or idle, and cruise motion stops with prefers-reduced-motion
Canvas resizes with the element through ResizeObserver
editableByProps: Button content through children and the rendered element through as (button, a, div)
Star and trail colors, background, text and border track colors
Speed, border thickness, corner radius, trail length, number of stars (1 to 6), glow strength
Sparkle on or off, travel direction, hover behavior, click pulse on or off
Dark or light theme, extra classes and inline style, any native element attributes via rest props

needsCodeEdit.change: Change padding, font weight or base layout of the element
Change theme default colors or add a new theme
Change the glow spread outside the element
Change duration of the hover lap

fixed: Canvas extends 48px beyond the element on every side, so the glow can overflow and be clipped by ancestors with overflow hidden
Uses canvas, ResizeObserver, IntersectionObserver and matchMedia, so it is client-only
Reads colors through a canvas context, so color props must be valid CSS colors
Values are clamped: duration min 0.3, thickness min 0.5, stars 1 to 6, trailLength and glow 0 to 1
Unknown hover values fall back to lap, unknown theme falls back to dark
Root is inline-flex with fixed px-6 py-3.5 padding and no frame, so it sits where placed
Works on small screens, size follows content, hover effects have no touch equivalent except the tap pulse

options.look: Near-black surface, white text, additive white light with bright glow
options.useWhen: Call-to-action button on a dark hero or dark landing page

options.look: White surface, dark text, dark light trail with softer glow
options.useWhen: Call-to-action button on a white or pastel marketing page
